say:1:1621768001:1.text: I-I can see Girod now! His spirit's here!
say:1:1621768001:1.source_cn: 看、看得见了！真的是吉罗德……他变成幽灵了……

say:1:1621768001:1.female: I-I can see Girod now! His spirit's here!

narration:3:1621768003:1.text: You briefly explain the incident and your conjectures to Girod.
narration:3:1621768003:1.male: You briefly explain the incident and your conjectures to Girod.
narration:3:1621768003:1.female: You briefly explain the incident and your conjectures to Girod.

say:4:1621768004:1.text: Hmm... you got almost everything right.
say:4:1621768004:1.source_cn: 嗯……你们猜的，基本都是对的。

say:5:1621768005:1.text: The "Mirror of Revelation" part was just nonsense, but when my boss got the mirror from an antique dealer...
say:5:1621768005:1.source_cn: “启示之镜”的名号虽然是老板编出来的噱头，但他从其他古...

say:6:1621768006:1.text: The dealer did mention it was previously owned by a powerful mage and can enhance both spiritual and magical strength.
say:6:1621768006:1.source_cn: 对面的卖家确实说，这个镜子很古老，曾是强大的魔法师的私...

say:8:1621768007:1.text: You decided to pray to the mirror after reading that novel?
say:8:1621768007:1.source_cn: 你看了那本小说，所以就想到要去和魔镜祈祷？

say:9:1621768008:1.text: Yes... I panicked over failing the final exam and got desperate. The novel gave me the idea to try the trick...
say:9:1621768008:1.source_cn: 嗯。重要的大考就要来了，我……我太着急了。我太害怕不及...

say:10:1621768009:1.text: I had the store key, so I slipped in at night and secretly prayed to the mirror, hoping to boost my mana. That way, I could pass the exam...
say:10:1621768009:1.source_cn: 我有店门钥匙，就在商业街关门后偷跑了进去，背着老板向古...

say:11:1621768010:1.text: The novel's protagonist had to pray many times to summon the mirror monster, so I figured it would be fine to try once...
say:11:1621768010:1.source_cn: 我当时想，故事里的主角用了那么多次，才把镜中人召唤出来...

say:12:1621768011:1.text: Little did I know, it showed up right on my first prayer and immediately trapped me inside the mirror...
say:12:1621768011:1.source_cn: 但没想到，镜人在第一次祈祷后，就从镜子里走了出来，还把...

say:14:1621768012:1.text: Wait, the book says the duplicate is supposed to help the summoner. Is something wrong with the magic?
say:14:1621768012:1.source_cn: 奇怪……这和书里写的不一样。难道是那个古老的召唤魔法发...
